assumptions.other_series_scope: Illustrative hot switches, parallel-inductor DCR, current sensing, PCB and connections. Replaces earlier0.75mohm allowance; not a measured stack.
assumptions.switch_example: IPT007N06N:60V,0.75mohm maximum at25C/10V gate. Three parallel per bridge position yields0.5mohm total two-position path at25C; an explicitly assumed2x hot factor gives1mohm. This does not qualify SOA, sharing, switching or layout.
assumptions.inductor_bank: Four AGP4233-332ME in parallel, nominal0.825uH, plus assumed0.2uH loop;0.1875mohm max25C parallel DCR, hot/ripple/core effects unresolved.
assumptions.frequency_scope: 200Hz only for electrical heat calculation; repeated jetting not established.

cases.method: Exact integrals of piecewise-linear prescribed current; V=IR+L dI/dt. Head modeled as constant cold resistance. Four-quadrant current regulation assumed.
limitations: No PWM ripple, switching/gate losses, current-loop dynamics, bus/lead ringing or protection design.
No capacitor ESR/ripple rating or switch SOA/temperature qualification.
Input R and L assumptions must be replaced with measured assembled values; motional voltage is omitted from this lumped check.
Electrical compliance is not a droplet or repetition-rate prediction.
